top news.title: SpaceXAI launches Grok 4.5, its first model built in partnership with Cursor, designed to “handle difficult, long-running” legal, finance, and coding tasks

tweets.author: @elonmusk
tweets.text: Our internal assessment is that Grok 4.5 is roughly comparable to Opus 4.7, but much faster.  The combination of capability, faster speed and lower cost is what makes it competitive.  We are closing the loop on real-world usefulness, not benchmarks.  Hardcore engineers at Tesla & SpaceX find Grok 4.5 genuinely useful, which is what actually matters.

tweets.author: @bridgemindai
tweets.text: New CursorBench results just dropped and Grok 4.5 is the story. #3 overall at 66.7%.  Right behind Fable 5 Max at 70.5%.  Now look at the cost column.  Fable 5 Max: $17.32 per task Grok 4.5 High: $1.51 per task That is Fable level performance at roughly 1/10th the cost.  And it beats Fable 5 High and Opus 4.8 Max outright.  The intelligence war just became a price war.

tweets.author: @zephyr_z9
tweets.text: Testing Grok 4.5 Won't be surprised if Elon cancels the Anthropic & Google agreements and gets back the compute xAI is bacc

sub_items.title: Grok 4.5 is available in Grok Build, in Cursor, and from the SpaceXAI console, but not in the EU; it costs $2 per 1M input tokens and $6 per 1M output tokens

top news.title: OpenAI says it will launch GPT-5.6 Sol, along with Terra and Luna, publicly on Thursday; a source says the US Department of Commerce approved a broad rollout

tweets.author: @synthwavedd
tweets.text: - GPT-5.6 will be the final model in the 5.x series.  GPT-6 is slated to launch in about a month, earlier than expected, and possibly even later this month - GPT-6 will be based on a new, significantly larger pretrain (versus the ~4T 5.5/5.6 ‘Spud’ base) - There is lots of excitement at OpenAI over this new base, which they believe will be much better able to compete with both Fable 5 and upcoming 5.1, targeting a similar release window

tweets.author: @emollick
tweets.text: My big takeaway is that both Sol & Fable represent jumps over previous models and have opened a large gap with the next-best AIs. People will have preferences for one or the other, but if you doing any work where better intelligence matters, those two models are your only choices

tweets.author: @thdxr
tweets.text: i've never hyped a model release, we're generally conservative with how we use these things but gpt-5.6 has had a massive impact on our team, we're using 5x the tokens as we used to it's not even smarter than fable or anything, but it's just so reliable and fun to use

sub_items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-Live, a new generation of voice models built on a full-duplex architecture, meaning they can listen and speak at the same time

top news.title: Apple reaches a deal with Broadcom worth $30B+ to make 15B+ chips in the US over the next five years, Apple's largest as part of its $600B US investment pledge

tweets.author: @tim_cook
tweets.text: We're proud to expand our work with Broadcom with a new agreement to produce billions more chips in the US! It's our largest ever American Manufacturing Program commitment and an important step in our work to build an end-to-end silicon supply chain in the US.

tweets.author: @patrickmoorhead
tweets.text: Broadcom nearly walked away from Apple and the smartphone wireless market when Apple started hard negotiating. How things have changed now that the chip providers have the upper hand. No, Apple isn't jacking around Micron anymore either. And is now friends with Nvidia.

tweets.author: @presssec
tweets.text: The Trump Effect: “Apple announced Wednesday it is investing more than $30 billion in chip manufacturing in the U.S. The investment, in partnership with Broadcom, is set to produce 15 billion chips, creating hundreds of U.S. jobs.”
